items.caption:
Alexandr Wang says Meta’s CFO pulled him aside many times with one message: this model has to work.

Wang leads Meta’s superintelligence lab. Susan Li told him that if the model is good, everything is fine, but if it is bad, it will be “very, very bad in financial terms.”

Would you take a job where the CFO tells you that?

Source: Cheeky Pint, Zuckerberg’s $100 Billion Bet. Full video: youtube.com/watch?v=XfdIhd1g6EI

items.caption:
Mark Zuckerberg says Meta’s huge AI bet only fails if AI itself fails.

His logic: if AI works, plenty of other companies will want Meta’s compute, at roughly $15 billion a gigawatt. And even if AI fails overall, Meta still has other ways to use all that compute.

Smart hedge or the biggest bet in tech history?

items.caption:
Elon Musk says China produces about three times as much electricity as the United States.

He thinks the US will figure out chips. The real long-term challenge, he says, is generating enough power and having enough chip factories in the US or a safe region.

Is power the real bottleneck for AI?
